# Workspace Instructions

- Project type: Python Playwright automation framework.
- Run tests with `python -m pytest`; use `scripts/run-tests.ps1` or `scripts/run-tests.sh` for browser-specific runs.
- Keep Page Objects in `pages/`, framework services in `framework/`, configuration in `config/`, and test data in `data/`.
- Validate Python changes with the smallest relevant Pytest selection before completing work.
